description: This is a Java entity class representing a Passenger in the KYC service platform, mapping to the 'passengers' database table. It contains fields for passenger details such as UUID, contact info, KYC status, and auxiliary metadata with JPA annotations.

classes.name: Passenger
classes.description: An entity class modeling passenger information and KYC status for persistence in a relational database.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: A callback method that initializes UUIDs and timestamps before persisting a new Passenger entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the UUID identifier of the passenger.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the UUID identifier of the passenger.

methods.name: getPhoneE164
methods.description: Retrieves the passenger's phone number in E.164 format.

methods.name: setPhoneE164
methods.description: Sets the passenger's phone number in E.164 format.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the email address of the passenger.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the passenger.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Retrieves the full name of the passenger.

methods.name: setFullName
methods.description: Sets the full name of the passenger.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Retrieves the date of birth of the passenger.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the date of birth of the passenger.

methods.name: getAadhaarLast4
methods.description: Retrieves the last 4 digits of the Aadhaar number.

methods.name: setAadhaarLast4
methods.description: Sets the last 4 digits of the Aadhaar number.

methods.name: getKycStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current KYC status of the passenger.

methods.name: setKycStatus
methods.description: Sets the KYC status of the passenger.

methods.name: getKycVerifiedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when KYC was verified.

methods.name: setKycVerifiedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when KYC was verified.

methods.name: getDigilockerUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the DigiLocker user ID associated with the passenger.

methods.name: setDigilockerUserId
methods.description: Sets the DigiLocker user ID.

methods.name: getDigilockerDocumentRefsJson
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON string references to DigiLocker documents.

methods.name: setDigilockerDocumentRefsJson
methods.description: Sets the JSON string references to DigiLocker documents.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the passenger record was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the created timestamp.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the passenger record was last updated.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last updated timestamp.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the UUID of the user who created the record.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the user who created the record.

methods.name: getUpdatedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the UUID of the user who last updated the record.

methods.name: setUpdatedBy
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the user who last updated the record.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the entity version for optimistic locking.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the entity version.
